# apple_beta_testers (Data Source)

Lists the beta testers that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_beta_testers" "public" {
  beta_group_id = apple_beta_group.public.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Only testers of this app.
- `beta_group_id` (String) Only testers in this beta group.
- `build_id` (String) Only testers given this build individually.
- `emails` (Set of String) Email addresses to match.

### Read-Only

- `beta_testers` (Attributes List) The matching testers, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--beta_testers))

<a id="nestedatt--beta_testers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `beta_testers`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the tester.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the tester.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the tester.
- `invite_type` (String) How the tester was invited: `EMAIL` or `PUBLIC_LINK`.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the tester.
- `state` (String) State of the tester's invitation.
